name: ChartQAPro
intro: ChartQAPro 是面向真实复杂图表的图表问答基准，包含来自 99 个在线来源的 1,341 张图表和 1,948 道经人工复核的问题，覆盖推理、对话、选择、假设、事实核验和不可回答场景。
org: York University, Mila, QCRI, NTU, Salesforce Research
build_method: 多来源真实图表收集, 九人标注, 多VLM辅助扩展, 双人独立复核与协商修订
metric: Enhanced Relaxed Accuracy（精确匹配、5%数值容差、ANLS）
eval_feature: 真实图表多样性, 图表-段落联合理解, 多题型, 不可回答问题
build_method_en: Multi-source Real-chart Collection, Nine-annotator QA Creation, Multi-VLM-assisted Expansion, Independent Dual-annotator Review and Consensus Revision
eval_feature_en: Real-world Chart Diversity, Chart-text Reasoning, Multiple QA Types, Unanswerable Questions
intro_en: ChartQAPro evaluates question answering over complex real-world charts. It contains 1,341 charts from 99 online sources and 1,948 human-reviewed questions spanning reasoning, conversational, multiple-choice, hypothetical, fact-checking, and unanswerable settings.
metric_en: Enhanced Relaxed Accuracy (Exact Match, 5% Numeric Tolerance, ANLS)
drawio_review_note: Aligned with ChartQAPro (Findings of ACL 2025), Section 3.1 and Figure 3. The final ACL version collects charts by web crawling and Google search from 99 online sources, manually filters for visual and topical diversity, preserves metadata such as URLs and alt text, and retains 1,341 charts. Nine team members create five QA families; five focus on reasoning while four cover the remaining categories. Annotators write seed pairs, use GPT-4o, Gemini, and Claude to generate five new pairs per seed and additional interactive candidates, then remove simple questions and revise ambiguous or incorrect items. A second annotator independently answers each item; disagreements are collaboratively resolved, with sub-1-percent differences accepted for subjective estimates. The final 1,948 questions include unanswerable and chart-text cases. Evaluation uses exact match for multiple-choice, fact-checking, and year answers; 5-percent relative tolerance for other numeric answers; and ANLS for text, aggregated as enhanced relaxed accuracy. The 99-source count follows the final ACL paper rather than the earlier arXiv abstract's 157-source claim.
